name: XCOPA: Cross-Lingual Choice of Plausible Alternatives
description: XCOPA is a benchmark dataset for causal commonsense reasoning across 11 diverse languages (Estonian, Haitian Creole, Indonesian, Italian, Kinyarwanda, Quechua, Swahili, Tamil, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Chinese). Modeled after the English COPA dataset, instances present a premise and ask which of two choices is more plausibly the cause or consequence.
